what: A typical residential natural gas customer's year, by state: the state's residential consumption over its residential customers, 2024.
method: Both EIA Natural Gas Annual tables were fetched as HTML on 2026-10-03 and the 2024 columns read. Mcf a customer = MMcf x 1,000 / customers. Therms = Mcf x 10.36, at 1,036 Btu a cubic foot, EIA's heat content of gas delivered to consumers. A ccf is a tenth of an Mcf.
notes: An average over every residential gas customer, heating or not, across the year; no month's share is kept.
The 2025 consumption column (NY 450,867, CA 408,468, CT 53,091 MMcf) has no 2025 customer count beside it yet, so 2024 is used.
